description: This file defines the PhpInputStream class, which extends the Stream class to provide a caching wrapper around the 'php://input' stream, commonly used to read raw data from HTTP requests in PHP web applications.

classes.name: PhpInputStream
classes.description: A specialized stream class that caches data read from 'php://input' for repeated access.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the stream object, defaulting to 'php://input'.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the cached content or reads and caches the stream content.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates that this stream is not writable.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream, updating the cache with the read content.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns all remaining contents of the stream, updating the cache.
